usedFor: ZenCommerce holds the online store and Loyverse the point of sale, so “Product Updated” can run “Create Or Update Variant”.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Updated” in ZenCommerce, then “Create Or Update Variant” in Loyverse
bestTemplate.why: A product edited online updates the matching variant in your point of sale, so both stay aligned.

watchOut: “New Order Created” in ZenCommerce also reaches “Create Or Update Variant”, so orders could also change variants.
